endings.name: The One Who Left
endings.summary: Tam drove out alone at dusk on day 2. Home is ordinary; nobody remembers the four friends or the campground, and the notebook is the only proof.

endings.name: Nothing Missing
endings.summary: Tam took the world's word five or more times and said nothing was wrong. The morning is ordinary, and there are fewer of them in the van.

endings.name: Held
endings.summary: The five sites held 12 or more weight at dark and stay in this world. Everything and everyone inside is safe, and no one outside remembers any of them.

endings.name: Brought Along
endings.summary: A person or party slept inside, but the sites did not hold. They cross with the friends, and someone at home no longer knows to wait.

endings.name: Slipped Through
endings.summary: The author's ending. Tam stayed and kept watching; on the final morning the sky is wrong and the phones show no signal, no time, no date. Added close: the walk out through the trees and a car arriving.
